new_value: Accepted: HKDF security proof is weaker with None salt but not exploitable here. Shared secret comes from X25519 DH with full entropy. Info-string domain separation (fedi-e2ee-xchacha20-v1) prevents cross-protocol attacks. Adding a salt would change the wire format.
